chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: Information Overload
subtitle: No need for investigation or deduction. Open your eyes and the truth is here.

trails.title: "The Dessert"
trails.description: A piece of news from an earlier time. It's broken, stained, giving off a bitter taste of obsolete sarcasm.

content.text:
{p}A company born of imagination. It fits the description of anything but a traditional security company — creative, unique, novel or unconventional. But personally, I'd choose the words "fancy bubbles".
{p}"Sticky balls" hidden above the ceiling, a tunnel dug inside the
chimney that goes right into
the cage, and a blanket can
refract light to create optical
illusion ... All these fancy
tricks came from their
astonishing imagination.
People need some occasional surprises to brighten their dull life, just like blowing a huge colorful bubble in the park at the weekend.
But every bubble will break eventually,won't they?

London Review, Opinions, 1962, 29(12A):23-34.{img}

trails.title: Final Course of Opportunism
trails.description: Every experienced thief who are also an opportunist should know to improvise.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Go! Turn on the emergency light and go check the circuit!

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: Copy that!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof.
A spotlight casts down from the ceiling and focuses on the brightest place—the showcase of the Rimet Cup.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: You moron! What're you doing! This is not the emergency light!

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: No, no, that wasn't me. The cup! The cup is missing!
Flawless protection is just a disguise, while threatening is the essence.
In such a dull and dreadful exhibition hall ...
Does anyone still remember ...
Those stories full of imagination and miracles?
All the lights shine on the glass showcase. She holds the Rimet Cup, just like hugging a long-lost friend.
Nobody notices that the name tag for the Rimet Cup has disappeared from the showcase.

items.speaker: Young Visitor
items.text: Whoa! Someone is in the case!

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: She … she holds the Rimet Cup?! How did she get in there!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Yes. It's finally back now, back to Ramirez.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Ramirez? Hahh! The company that forged the Rimet Cup and went bankrupt!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: You are …

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Oh, it's been a long time.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The leader of New Humans, the witness to the events that year, and the lucky man who finally retrieved the Rimet Cup—Mr. Iverson.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You know the story of the Rimet Cup better than anyone, don't you?

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Who are you?!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You were repelled by Ramirez's novelty and hated their surprising imagination and miracle stories one after another.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: "Apparently, it is better to follow the rules, even if we fail. We'll have nothing to be blamed ..."

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: To bury that shining star, the peers jointly forged a Rimet Cup, and carefully schemed a security commission that was doomed to fail.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Bollocks! You are a thief! You're not going to defame us!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Heh heh ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The Ramirezs have a tradition of leaving arcane marks on each item for safekeeping.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The marks will be revealed with special cameras.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Yes. This is the real Rimet Cup that we have never protected before.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Now, I've finally found the truth.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Oh, sorry. I forgot to introduce myself. You may call me The Great Thief Acey.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: For heaven's sake! She is that thief who stole countless treasures!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Or, my real name, of course—

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Melania Ramirez.

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: Mr. Iverson … what shall we do?

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Don't listen to her!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Are you going to believe a thief?

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: But there's no article on guidance that we could follow to deal with a situation like this ...

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Fathead!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Put her down, then everything will be fine!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Guns ready!
Iverson stares at Melania like a demon. The veins on his arms burst. He furtively presses the almost imperceptible button on the remote control.
The backs of the robots fall off, unveiling the bloody black guns. They slowly move upwards, aiming for the highest spot.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: I thought I would never use these steel bullets.
He presses the button.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Looks like you guys made the worst choice.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Well, it's not surprising.
Iverson falls to the ground, dropping the remote control aside. It's like a period in the whole story.
Those "bullets" and tranquilizers flying towards Melania suddenly explode.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Oh, I forgot to tell you that some of the equipment carried by the robots have violated the Guidance on Security. So, I replaced them with safer firework bullets.
All people are drowned in the halo of the fireworks. The puppy dashes fearlessly towards Iverson's remote control.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof!
This is a parting gift after all the failures.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Eroj Exchange!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Sorry, but it's better to destroy the remote control that will place our security at risk as early as possible, okay?
She laughs, snaps her fingers, and disappears.
What remains is the exhibition name tag for the Rimet Cup, which appears again on the showcase.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Wait! Look at that dog!

items.speaker: Wendy
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: No, not that one! Look at that border collie!

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: He found us the Rimet Cup!!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof?
TO BE CONTINUED ...
